title: SEC to address crypto regulations in absence of CLARITY passage
summary: The US securities regulator scheduled a meeting this week with the potential to step up on digital asset policies without congressional action.

title: Itaú joins Brazil tokenization pilot with OpenAssets
summary: The bank will test tokenized fixed-income securities and investment funds as part of an ANBIMA-led industry pilot.

title: MoneyGram expands crypto cash ramps to Solana
summary: MoneyGram’s Ramps service now connects Solana wallets and applications to its global cash network, with Rift becoming the first wallet to integrate the service.

title: Following Senate delay, crypto bill has a narrow window to become law
summary: After an August recess, lawmakers in the Senate will have just 36 days in session before the end of the year to pass the CLARITY Act.

title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year
summary: The company has bought roughly 25 times more BTC than it has sold this year, despite recent sales that challenged its long-standing accumulation strategy.

title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
summary: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation data
summary: The legal action against Kalshi focused on trademark infringement and injury to its reputation in addition to citing state authorities comparing the company’s contracts to gambling.

title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
summary: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
summary: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.

title: Bitcoin drops to one-week low as retail buys gold at highest prices since June
summary: Bitcoin price action sank to one-week lows ahead of US CPI data, while retail investors piled into gold ETFs and XAU/USD hit its highest levels in nine weeks.
